Player Impressions:
Hoyos - an average performance so far.  Doing well in distribution.  He was well beaten on the 1st goal as he has a known limitation in his reach.  The 2nd goal could be viewed as a defensive failure, or he didn't come off his line.  
Edwards - Has mostly been playing as a right mid/winger.  Has grown into his attack, and putting the ball into dangerous areas.  Reading the ball well.
Gregersen - playing well tonight.  Has come up big a few times to prevent New England passing.
Alonso - I don't see him communicating as much, but doing well in distribution.  Has gotten the ball up the pitch well.
Muyumba - Has made a few outsanding defensive plays.  When he wins the ball, can't quickly determine what to do with it.  Needs more time.  When he has that time, is able to pick out nice through balls up to the front line.
Báez - I can't tell what position he's being asked to play.  It's too high up for a FB.  He's not often getting up the wing.  He stays somewhere between FB and LM.  Which often leaves him isolated and unable to defend.
Reilly - Has not been able to control midfield.  Is often seen along the back line.
Sanchez - Is overpowered centrally.  He seems to have trouble with Almirón, Miranchuk, and Picault running freely and switching sides.  He can't find targets.
Almirón - The team's captain today.  In name and spirit.  He's running all over, and playing very well in both offense and defense.  He looks frustrated at times when he makes wonderful plays, when his target loses the ball.  He is freely moving right, left, central.  Pops up everywhere making life difficult for New England, and giving Atlanta options.
Miranchuk - Staying more on the right.  Having a good game.  Is good with his passing.  Needs to move around more, away from the right.
Picault - This is not his natural position.  With his age, doing what he can to press the line and provide options.  But Atlanta should really be using a natural striker like Togashi or Kovac.  Picault is being outrun.

Best players are Almirón, and Miranchuk close behind.  But they're being asked to do too much.  They cannot do it all, and it glaring how much the team needs a finisher.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - He was lit up tonight.  Mostly due to the defense, but he could have done better with his movement before the shots.  He could have preventing some that he didn't.  But the balls should never have gotten that far.  So hard to fault him too much.
Báez - badly beaten on defence.  Pulled out of shape far too often.
Alonso - a few good passes.  Is not organizing the back line well.  Is not the savior.
Gregersen - Is good when he's fit and in the first half.  Still made of glass.  Out of energy by the 60th and gets dinged up.
Edwards - Was decent in the first half, moving the ball up.  Pllaying more as a winger than defender.  If that's intentional, he's doing good.  If not, he's not playing defensive enough.
Reilly - flat out, out-played in midfield
Muyumba - same as the first half, good moments defensively.  Tries good through balls which may not work.  Needs too long on the ball to find a pass
Almirón - A really good shift.  He's all over the pitch.  Working hard to be the pass and make the pass.  Will work well with an actual striker
Sanchez - out played in midfield.  didn't make an impact
Miranchuk - working real hard.  very good movement.  Still gives the ball away occasionally.
Picault - had nothing in the 2nd half.  Looked out of gas.  Should have been subbed early.
Brennan - good ball movement, and passing.  Nearly had 2 goals.  THis was the kind of play he needed to keep him on the pitch.
Hernández - didn't have much of an impact.  Teammates wouldn't pass to him on the right as they were mostly trying up the middle.
Mihaj - miscommunication with Alonso.  Didnt' help too much.
Togashi - Was a part of the pinball movement to setup the goal.  But wasn't able to get open enough to receive the ball.
